value_range_characterization.unit_interpretation: Raw amplitude DN from 10x10 block mean aggregation of Level-1 SAR intensity
value_range_characterization.note: Values are positive raw amplitude; no dB conversion, no absolute radiometric calibration. Future training must decide: use raw DN, apply 10*log10, or apply ESA calibration constants.

aggregation_method.description: 10x10 spatial block mean of Li-slice float32 array
aggregation_method.note: Li slices are 256x256 in the catalog. The 10x10 block mean is applied from the cropped Level-1 GRD window to produce the 256x256 OPS-01 image. This is the EMPIRICALLY_SUPPORTED_PILOT_HYPOTHESIS correspondence method.
